before backup create or restore calls MkdirAll for a caller-selected output parent, the real CLI walks its missing path segment to the first existing entry and rejects a symlink or non-directory there. the former sequential deterministic-runtime coverage is split into eight required parallel jobs: core Go/CLI regression, two exhaustive deterministic learner-Bot top-level-test shards, learner Bot race regression, isolated beginner quickstart, and three independently bootstrapped M00-M11 smoke/mutation groups. before recovery admission compares a caller-supplied handoff with the old stopped runtime, the real command uses the shared strict JSON decoder. A duplicate key or trailing value cannot collapse through generic map decoding into canonical-looking lineage; the real CLI regression proves duplicate profile input returns REJECTED without changing the new runtime registry. the required n8n-engine-regression job remains visible on every PR but installs/runs the disposable M06/M07 engine only for n8n/adapter/runner/workflow changes; it always runs on main pushes. when the M11 fixture outcome JSONL writer reports an error after the exact line is replayable, or cleanup fails after its matching post-ledger transition is already canonical, the real m11-outcome command reports PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED with the deterministic outcome/post-ledger transition and leaves the journal for locked recovery. A fresh Bot fails closed; an exact retry returns EXACT_DUPLICATE without a second outcome. when canonical history append reports an error after the exact record is replayable, AppendHistory, direct M06 history-handoff, fixture-import CLI, pinned-fixture fetch CLI, and the workflow-facing M06 adapter expose PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED instead of a retryable HANDOFF_ERROR. when the shared JSONL writer reports an error after an exact M03 action, M04 outcome, M05 evaluation/proposal/review line became readable, the real CLI command canonical-reloads it and reports PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED; an exact retry is EXACT_DUPLICATE. when the shared JSONL writer reports an error after an exact M10 fixture outcome line became readable, the real m10-outcome command canonical-reloads it and reports PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED; an exact retry is EXACT_DUPLICATE. a test-owned barrier releases 24 separately built Bot processes against one M10 CANCELLED/NOT_PERFORMED execution. Exactly one distinct fixture outcome appends; all other contenders are BUSY or CONFLICT. A fresh Bot and backup v3 restore replay exactly that one outcome. mission status, M10/M11 artifact resolvers, M11 recovery export and the old source of recovery admission require a direct non-symlink state root before gate, journal or registry reads. A real status command rejects a symlink alias to an initialized external runtime. Portable inputs, ancestor-path TOCTOU, crash, power-loss and multi-host guarantees remain open

every learner mission command that mutates runtime state requires its direct state root to be a non-symlink directory before a lock, recovery journal or mission state can be created; when a runtime root is missing, it rejects a symlink in the missing path segment before MkdirAll can create externally. Before MkdirAll, the immediate parent and missing parent segment must be non-symlink directories; real publisher regressions reject an identical external symlink before/after descriptor open and a symlink/missing parent before any external directory is created. canonical JSONL reads reject a symlink or same-byte name replacement from Lstat through open/fstat and a second identity check on Close; a fully consumed reader also hashes the opened descriptor and rereads that descriptor on Close, rejecting a same-inode in-place content rewrite before canonical loaders acknowledge a parse. History and derived-store loaders propagate a successful parse's Close error. Appends retain inode identity through sync, close and acknowledgement; a target that appears after an absent append check must be created with O_EXCL. the bounded reader used by all learner-module direct production file inputs, CLI capture/config/fixture inputs, local campaign files, M07 registry/model/tool-result files, M03-M06 action/outcome/context/config/history-handoff inputs, selected ACCESSTRADE report/manifest inputs and every command-supplied M08-M11 artifact keeps a regular-file identity from Lstat through open, two bounded descriptor reads and the final pathname check. The selected ACCESSTRADE Shopee sanitized-capture import rejects a same-byte external symlink replacement after open before history persistence; the real M03 action command rejects the same replacement before action persistence; the internal app/store reader rejects that replacement before action, outcome, evidence or learning-report decode; the real M07 registration command rejects it before evidence persistence; the real M10 reservation command rejects it before budget mutation; and CI mutation proves each shared wrapper cannot fall back to os.ReadFile. The real registry tests replace a prechecked registry with a same-byte external symlink immediately before append and prove the external target remains byte-identical. the learner M07 registry loader strict-decodes executable policy before host/method/redirect validation, rejecting duplicate keys, case-variant and unknown fields, and trailing JSON; mutation replaces that decoder with json.Unmarshal and must make the real learner regression fail. Selected-source, provider, execution and business evidence remain open

the M07 boundary strict-decodes the complete untrusted model payload before semantic grounding, rejecting duplicate keys at every depth, case-variant and unknown typed fields, and trailing JSON; mutation replaces that decoder with json.Unmarshal and must make the real core regression fail. A same-byte external symlink replacement after open is rejected before a replay plan can be parsed; crash, power-loss, multi-host and other runtime-store races remain open

on Linux/macOS the M10 execution recovery journal rejects a FIFO before recovery/status/reader can open it; Windows FIFO behavior plus crash, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

on Linux/macOS each M11 direct-STOP, FAILED, UNKNOWN and outcome recovery journal rejects a FIFO or symlink before recovery/status/reader can open it; Windows FIFO behavior plus crash, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

learner M11 registry loading rejects a schema-valid, entry-integrity-valid lease approval with no immutable lease parent before runtime use by invoking canonical graph validation; broader semantic orphan, crash and multi-host coverage remains open

readiness audit requires M10/M11 immutable-ID, backup source-identity and canonical runtime-store path mutation commands to exist and remain wired to curriculum CI, with negative fixtures for removed commands; it does not fetch remote CI evidence or expand mutation coverage beyond those bounded guards

canonical mission state/STOP, M10 registry/cost bounds/fixture outcomes and M11 registry/fixture outcomes use the stable regular-file reader before parse or authority graph validation; same-byte valid external symlink targets and same-inode content rewrites after its first complete read are rejected without mutation. The shared reader also services backup copies, M07 sidecars and recovery journals. This bounded local check is not an atomic snapshot against an uncooperative writer that races or restores bytes; other runtime stores, crash, multi-host and operated filesystem evidence remain open

CI makes a disposable Bot copy, removes the composite Lstat/open-fstat/post-read stable regular-file identity guard, and requires real same-byte source-symlink-swap regressions during backup inventory and restore-after-verification to fail at their dedicated assertions. Restore also reads its inventory-selecting manifest through the shared reader and rejects a same-byte manifest symlink before inventory or target publication; this narrow proof excludes broad race, crash, multi-host and operated backup coverage

CI makes isolated copies, removes each canonical M10 gate, authorization and terminal execution ID check in turn, and requires the real matching forged-ID graph assertion to fail; this narrow mutation proof does not cover mutable ledger, restore, crash, multi-host, executor or operated evidence

CI makes isolated copies, removes each canonical M11 gate, authorization and execution ID check in turn, and requires the real matching forged-ID graph assertion to fail; this narrow mutation proof does not cover ledger, restore, crash, multi-host or operated evidence

canonical M11 graph recomputes deterministic gate, authorization and execution IDs after resolving immutable parents, while learner reuses those core builders and journal fixtures use canonical identities; mutable ledger transactions, executor, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

canonical M10 graph recomputes each terminal execution ID only after resolving its immutable authorization, rejecting a forged ID even when every lineage link remains consistent; mutable reservation ledger, executor, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

canonical M10 graph recomputes deterministic gate and authorization IDs only after resolving their immutable parents, rejecting forged IDs even when downstream links were rewritten consistently; mutable reservation ledger, executor, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open
canonical M10 graph permits one terminal no-side-effect execution record per authorization; mutable reservation ledger, executor, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open
canonical M10 graph rejects duplicate immutable registry kind/ID entries before map resolution; ledger transaction, executor, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

canonical M10 graph validates grant/cost/gate/authorization/execution immutable links and learner calls that shared implementation; mutable reservation ledger, executor, atomic crash and multi-host proof remain open

canonical M11 graph rejects a second recovery admission for either the same new lease or the same prior-runtime/human-resolution lineage; this is deterministic audit integrity, not atomic recovery, power-loss or multi-host proof

a recovery admission requires the exact immutable new-lease approval to be present and reviewed before its own human review timestamp. Canonical graph validation and the real learner registry loader reject an entry-integrity-valid lease plus admission whose named approval is absent. This bounded semantic graph guard does not prove cross-runtime source lineage, atomic recovery, power-loss or multi-host safety

the M11 fixture outcome loader rejects two otherwise valid distinct outcome IDs that cite one MACHINE_EXECUTION ID. This aligns direct runtime reads with the command writer and backup graph, so malformed JSONL cannot reach evaluation or recovery as two outcomes for one execution. It is a bounded fixture-store cardinality guard, not business-outcome ingestion, atomic recovery, power-loss or multi-host proof

learner and harness share strict M09 approval and non-authorizing validation of proposal-only intent, semantic M08 policy, human one-time approval, links and time; the harness additionally uses core/m09 for APPROVED_LIVE authorization and execution-record decoding. A schema-valid impossible ALLOW/RISK2 policy is rejected before bind mutation; duplicate approval input rejects without mutation and a reloaded DENY policy cannot reserve; duplicate/unknown authorization and execution fields and non-M09 authorization profiles reject through core/m09. Policy-context provenance/re-evaluation, full cross-artifact chain conformance, migration, live executor and multi-file crash proof remain open

after an injected M10 registry-before-state commit fault, or an execution journal rename that is visible before its parent-directory sync is confirmed, a newly built Bot process returns RECOVERY_REQUIRED from status and artifact resolution before any locked recovery can reconcile the journal. The visible journal maps to PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, creates no portable execution output, and an exact locked retry binds/registers precisely one record. This is bounded process-restart coverage, not a kill/power-loss, multi-file atomicity or multi-host proof

when the M11 outcome recovery journal is rename-visible but its parent-directory sync is unconfirmed, the real m11-outcome command reports PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED with its deterministic outcome/post-ledger transition. A fresh Bot blocks status and resolver until an exact locked retry replays one outcome and ledger transition. This is bounded local recovery, not multi-file atomicity, kill/power-loss or multi-host proof

when either M11 FAILED-execution or UNKNOWN-to-STOP recovery journal is rename-visible but parent-directory sync is unconfirmed, or its cleanup fails after execution/ledger (and for UNKNOWN durable STOP) are canonical, the real command reports PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED with the deterministic execution/next-ledger transition. A fresh Bot blocks status and resolver until an exact locked retry replays one execution and its ledger/STOP transition. This is bounded local recovery, not multi-file atomicity, kill/power-loss or multi-host proof

M10 trusted cost-bound registration writes a bounded local recovery journal before converging its immutable artifact envelope and compact cost-bound index. Injected failures before artifact, after artifact, after index, or after the journal is visible but before its parent-directory sync make status/resolver fail closed; the visible journal maps to PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, and only a locked retry or backup create replays the exact observed bound then returns an exact duplicate. This excludes whole-runtime atomicity, kill/power-loss and multi-host guarantees

M10 canary admission journals its immutable grant registry entry with the mutable mission-state binding/counters. Injected failures before artifact, after artifact, after state, or after the journal is visible but before its parent-directory sync make status/resolver fail closed; the visible journal maps to PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, and only a locked retry or backup create replays the exact grant then ACKs. This excludes whole-runtime atomicity, kill/power-loss and multi-host guarantees

ACCESSTRADE outcome/receipt and M10 cost-bound JSONL snapshot writes read an existing target through the stable regular-file reader and reject an external symlink or post-read replacement before publish. An absent target is published by non-overwriting hard-link so a newly appeared path cannot be overwritten. This excludes broader TOCTOU, power-loss, multi-host and real business-report evidence

M10 pending execution journals must be regular files inside the runtime. A fresh Bot process rejects a symlink journal before status, resolver, writer or backup can follow it, leaving state, registry and the external target unchanged; multi-file crash, power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

one shared real-Bot workspace now names EC-01 through EC-05: generated M09/M10 no-side-effect fixture lineage resolves after backup/restore; missing/tampered/expired cost, unregistered gate/authorization and invalid EffectRefs reject with byte-identical canonical state; UNKNOWN exact retry remains stopped and reconciliable across restart. Multi-file crash, power-loss, multi-host and live-executor proof remain open
M10 cost registration canonicalizes valid pretty JSON to one JSONL record and uses the shared file-plus-directory-sync append boundary before ACK; power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

M10 and M11 append-only artifact registries bind a regular-file identity from pre-open through post-sync acknowledgement and sync their parent directory before success; M11 recovery regressions exercise pre-write, post-write and post-file-plus-directory-sync bounded journal failures. Power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

backup and restore stage each new copied file with file sync plus directory-lineage sync before graph verification and atomic rename under a target publisher gate. Backup reopens sources through a stable regular-file reader that rejects a symlink/inode swap after inventory. Before/after-write, post-file-sync, pre-directory-sync and post-directory-sync staging faults leave no target and retries publish a complete snapshot. After final rename, either parent-directory sync succeeds before BACKED_UP/RESTORED or a visible target yields PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED and a same-target retry is rejected; power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

JSONL append succeeds only after file and parent-directory sync; an injected post-write/pre-sync failure returns an error rather than an acknowledgement and a later append preserves valid line framing; power-loss and multi-host proof remain open

immutable JSON artifact output is written and fsynced in a sibling temporary file then published only by atomic non-overwriting hard link. An injected pre-publish fault leaves no target or temporary artifact; after Link makes the artifact visible but before parent-directory sync, the publisher returns a typed uncertainty and M08 intent/policy CLI, M07 CLI/HTTP adapter, and M11 recovery-export return PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED with the visible non-authorizing artifact rather than claiming ordinary persistence failure. M07 returns its validated deterministic trace/proposal identity only with this non-ACK status so callers can exact-retry but cannot consume it downstream. An exact retry resolves only the same immutable bytes. This bounded local syscall state does not prove durability through power-loss or multi-host filesystems

history list/replay/decision export, mock advisor context and ACCESSTRADE receipt listing acquire the local history runtime gate and fail closed while a writer is active; distributed or multi-host locking remains open

canonical HTTP history reads fail closed under the local history writer gate, and HTTP/M06/fetch handoff append plus replayed ACK run in one local critical section; distributed or multi-host locking remains open

M03-M05 derived-store list commands acquire the local history runtime gate and fail closed while a writer is active, preventing a local mixed history/action/outcome/evaluation snapshot; distributed or multi-host locking remains open
M08 intent construction and agent-proposal policy resolution acquire the local history runtime gate and fail closed while a watcher writer is active; distributed or multi-host locking remains open
M07 CLI and adapter history reads acquire the local history runtime gate and fail closed while a watcher writer is active; distributed or multi-host locking remains open
the canonical synthetic M06 offer builder projects null or absent price/commission fields as null, missing and unknown without inventing a seller value; governed selected-source profiles remain open

M07 tool-result/proposal commands reject same-path, hardlink and symlink output aliases before reading canonical/model/tool inputs; input bytes remain unchanged, while writer inventory breadth remains open

the canonical M10 gate rejects a trusted cost bound that would exceed a near-int64-max grant ledger through remaining-capacity subtraction, without integer wrap or execution authority; multi-file crash recovery remains open

a synchronized real-Bot STOP versus M10 reserve race permits at most the operation that acquired the local runtime gate first; durable STOP then rejects every later reservation without mutation, while distributed/multi-host locking and crash atomicity remain open

a 24-process test-owned start barrier launches separately built real Bot M10 and M11 governed-reservation commands for one cap=1 slot. M10 commits exactly one reservation while remaining contenders are BUSY or budget-denied and a fresh Bot status process replays its counters. M11 uses 24 distinct canonical authorizations bound to one immutable ALLOW gate/pre-ledger: exactly one appends, remaining contenders are BUSY or reject after the gate becomes stale, the winner exact-retries once, losers reject, and the M11 ledger head has exactly one pending execution. A separate 24-process M11 outcome barrier starts from one FAILED fixture execution and the same immutable outcome/predecessor ledger: exactly one command appends, every contender is APPENDED/BUSY/EXACT_DUPLICATE, all later exact retries resolve without a second JSONL record or ledger transition, and the head has one outcome link with no pending outcome. Distributed/multi-host locking, kill/power-loss and multi-file atomicity remain open

injected failures after temporary-file sync and immediately before the atomic mission-state rename make the real M10 governed reservation return STORE_ERROR, preserve byte-identical state and leave no temporary state file. A separately built fresh Bot then consumes the unchanged cap=1 exactly once; a second reservation remains rejected and persisted counters match the one ACK. This bounded local failure seam does not prove kill/power-loss, failures at every syscall, multi-file atomicity or distributed locking

after an atomic runtime-file rename, a parent-directory sync fault maps to PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED instead of retryable STORE_ERROR. The real M10 cap=1 reservation is visible, exact retry is EXACT_DUPLICATE, a new reservation remains denied and a fresh Bot replays it. Direct durable STOP now journals its exact reason before state and marker writes; after any journal/state/marker rename-visible fault, a fresh read-only Bot returns RECOVERY_REQUIRED and a locked writer completes the exact state/marker pair before retaining STOPPED. A second stop cannot overwrite either stored reason; a CI mutation removes that guard only in a disposable checkout and the real byte-identity regression must fail. This bounded recovery excludes power-loss, multi-file atomicity and distributed locking
M10 artifact resolution holds the local runtime gate, so a local writer blocks a competing read before journal or registry inspection; distributed/multi-host locking remains open

recovery export, M11 resolve and mission status hold the local runtime gate while reading journals and lifecycle state, so a local writer blocks a competing handoff or partial read; distributed/multi-host locking remains open
recovery admission holds the old runtime gate before reading a stopped lineage, so a local old writer blocks admission without new-runtime mutation; distributed/multi-host locking remains open

M11 recovery rejects symlink or special-file journals before reading an external replay plan or mutating the runtime; a fresh Bot process reports RECOVERY_REQUIRED for each bounded UNKNOWN, FAILED and outcome journal, then only its locked writer prelude may replay the exact transition. Process-crash and multi-host recovery proof remain open
reject ledger times before a registered activation; interim registry drafts remain outside completed backup snapshots
validate new-runtime lease, approval, activation and normal-ledger links only; never infer the prior runtime from a path
one admission per new lease and prior resolution lineage
activation at expiry and canonical same-ID lease rebind reject without registry mutation
health observation must fall within its exact lease window

canonical registry accepts only a post-attempt human NOT_PERFORMED resolution of an UNKNOWN reconciliation-required execution
canonical registry accepts at most one reconciliation resolution per UNKNOWN execution
canonical registry requires evaluation after execution and cycle close at or after that evaluation
canonical production cycle records are accepted only when their lifecycle status is CLOSED
canonical registry accepts at most one execution record per immutable authorization
canonical registry accepts at most one outcome evaluation and one closed cycle per execution
canonical authorization issuance and expiry must remain within its trusted cost-bound validity window
canonical registry requires each execution to resolve to a prior normal reservation ledger containing its pending execution ID
canonical ALLOW gate must retain a normal non-reconciliation ledger with exact budget snapshot counters
canonical gate requires its exact lease activation and cannot evaluate before that activation
canonical authorization executor must be explicitly allowed by its immutable production lease
canonical gate evaluation cannot predate its exact health snapshot observation
canonical ALLOW gate requires a healthy, complete, non-alert, non-reconciliation snapshot within lease thresholds
canonical ALLOW gate requires remaining execution, window, pending and cost capacity in its exact ledger snapshot
canonical ALLOW gate risk class must be permitted by both its immutable lease and exact human lease approval
canonical execution reservation ledger must be NORMAL and recorded no earlier than its immutable authorization and no later than its attempt
canonical fixed-window ledger history cannot reset window start or lower executions-in-window across append-only entries
canonical ledger counters must increase exactly with newly pending reservation execution IDs; swaps cannot create uncharged capacity
canonical ledger history cannot erase prior outcome links, successful idempotency keys, or reconciliation resolution IDs
canonical graph rejects duplicate artifact kind/ID pairs before map-based link resolution
canonical ledger outcome links must resolve a same-lease execution at or before observation time

all stores opened through the shared JSONL reader reject a non-empty final record without LF, so history, M03 action, M04 outcome, M05 evaluation/proposal/review and ACCESSTRADE receipt consumers cannot accept a possibly interrupted append. The M10 artifact/cost-bound and M11 artifact registries, M10/M11 fixture outcome loaders, and ACCESSTRADE backup receipt requirement split already-stable byte snapshots but now apply the same framing check before parsing. Real action/outcome commands reject without changing the corrupted store. This is a bounded local integrity guard, not a crash/power-loss, atomic multi-file or multi-host guarantee

m10-gate and m10-authorize register their immutable canonical artifacts before any caller-selected portable output. If that output is unavailable because an existing immutable path conflicts, the non-zero response is CANONICAL_ARTIFACT_REGISTERED_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE and includes the durable gate or authorization artifact for m10-resolve or exact safe republish; the existing output bytes remain unchanged. A parent-directory-sync uncertainty still maps to PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED. This local envelope/recovery boundary does not prove multi-file atomicity, crash/power-loss durability, a live executor or business outcome

the canonical M10 gate ID commits the explicit evaluation time as well as immutable grant/cost/intent/policy and ledger snapshot. Two valid evaluations at different RFC3339 times therefore retain distinct immutable IDs, while the same exact evaluation remains deterministic; artifact graph validation recomputes that same time-bound identity and the real learner Bot registers/resolves both gates through its append-only registry. This fixes an append-only registry collision only and does not authorize execution, prove wall-clock trust, multi-file atomicity, crash/power-loss recovery or business outcome

the immutable M11 production authorization ID is a digest of gate ID, executor ID and authorized_at. Two schema-valid authorizations for the same gate/executor but distinct authorization times therefore receive distinct IDs; graph validation recomputes that exact identity, learner lifecycle uses it, the real compiled-Bot backup smoke registers both and rejects their stale reservation attempts after one gate advances the ledger, and the existing mutation regression removes the same time-bound check in a disposable tree. This prevents append-only registry collision only; it does not authorize another reservation/execution, prove clock trust, ledger atomicity, crash/power-loss recovery, multi-host behavior or business outcome

after a M10 or M11 immutable registry line has been file-synced and its pathname verified, an unavailable parent-directory sync is typed as immutable publish uncertainty rather than an ordinary append failure. M10 gate and authorization CLI paths report PUBLISHED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED with their durable resolvable artifact and skip portable output; M11 direct registry append plus activation, ledger-init, gate, authorization, reservation, offline evaluation, closed-cycle, reconciliation and recovery-admission CLI paths disclose their visible artifact or completed ledger transition, which resolves or is the canonical ledger head, then exact-retries only after the uncertainty clears. This bounded local recovery disclosure does not prove directory durability through power loss, atomic multi-file transitions, multi-host behavior, execution or business outcome

the disposable M06/M07 engine and real M06 Schedule Trigger regressions were reproduced on macOS arm64 with n8n 2.38.1 and Node 24.21.0 after native isolated-vm was rebuilt by that same Node major. On 2026-09-14, both runners passed again against main d0d02c0 with the local Node 24 PATH and a disposable loopback adapter: M06 Schedule Trigger appended once, exact-deduplicated across n8n/adapter restart, and failed closed while the adapter was unavailable; M06/M07 engine cases persisted only canonical grounded fixture output and rejected invalid tool/model cases. CI pins Node 24 before installing n8n. This only records a local fixture/runtime compatibility boundary; it does not verify a deployed topology, provider credential, selected-source capture, business outcome or production support
